question: Where should the practitioner contemplate the deity Viṣṇu as present?
premises: Meditation on the deity Viṣṇu is enjoined.
Viṣṇu is described as present in the bodies of guru and priest.
The contemplative locus is explicitly specified.
inference: One should meditate on Viṣṇu as present in the bodies of the guru and the priest.
plain_english: One should meditate on the deity Viṣṇu as present in the bodies of the guru and the priest.
